about: Please-check types GV's learned list may NEVER suppress, whatever GV's reviewer clicked (plan 'Why not all 50', Phase 4, M13c; Greptile keeps a never-suppress list too). Reds and anything code proved are never suppressible in code (learned.py); this file adds the types tied to the client's settled rules. A type is tied to a rule when one of the rule's words is a whole word or phrase of the type's words (the part after 'A: ', 'D: ' ...). Generic words only: no project, drawing or client value.

letters.A: Sizes: the client settled exact match in inches and 'flag everything'; the reviewer clears false alarms one by one (the client's settled answers: units and matching).

makers.architect_items: the finish check against the architect (code)
makers.filler_range: GV's filler range (the client's email, a GV note)
makers.sink_centre: the sink centre on the sink base (GV's formula)
makers.splash_views: the splash sizes on the architect's other views (code)

rules.name: Cabinet run distribution (fillers first, then the door cabinets equally)
Countertop widths match the architect's drawing
Countertop back offset at least 2 1/2 inches
Countertop depth = cabinet depth + front overhang
Sink cabinet width against its cutout and clearances
Sink cutout depth (D) from the sink's inside depth
Sink cutout width (A) from the sink's inside width
Sink front offset 4 inches (a job setting)
Countertop width = wall to wall + 1 inch field cut per wall end
